Anmol Garg:

ixigo's Q2 FY27 Earnings Call. With us are Mr Aloke Bajpai, Chairman, MD, and Group

Aloke Bajpai: 
Thank you. Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for joining our Q2 FY27 Earnings Call 
on what is technically a long weekend. And I'm assuming many of you have booked your 
long weekend this time using ixigo, ConfirmTkt or AbhiBus. 
 
At ixigo, our ambition is to build the best customer experience for travel. We've built our 
business by understanding where our journey becomes stressful and then using technology 
to give people more certainty and peace of mind. Once we prove our ability to deliver peace 
of mind, we have seen that it builds customer loyalty and trust. 
 
This quarter, we have made progress across the business in quite different market conditions 
across these lines of business. Trains recovered with some of the base effect of policy changes 
starting to go away, buses continued to grow strongly and secularly, and hotels took a great 
leap forward, getting to a critical mass that makes it large enough to start disclosing. 
 
Flights faced a tougher external environment with high fares and limited capacity affecting 
bookings growth, and the overall market was down nearly 6% in volume terms in the quarter. 
Despite that, the team pulled off 7% segment growth, which in itself is an achievement. 
 
In Q2 FY27, we delivered resilient growth on quarterly GTV as well of INR5,304 crores, up 
22% Y-o-Y, and revenue from operations of INR321 crores, up 13% Y-o-Y. Our PAT was 
an all-time high, aided by our partial sale of stake in Freshbus. 
 
Flight and bus led the quarter with GTV growth of 37% and 32% Y-o-Y, respectively. From 
this quarter onwards, we are also disclosing a new line of business of hotels, which grew 
GTV 2.6x Y-o-Y, INR 211 crores, with a gross take rate of more than 12%.

Before Saurabh takes you through the numbers in detail, let me deep dive a bit into each line 
of business and give some colour on the choices we are making for the next phase of growth. 
The recovery in trains was encouraging. 
 
Advanced bookings for Dussehra and Diwali helped volumes, and we stepped up our focus 
on growth again, while maintaining healthy unit economics. However, we want to see that 
momentum continue beyond the festive season before calling it a sustained recovery. 
 
I also want to mention that ConfirmTkt now has a 4.9 rating on the Google Play Store. And 
among the apps that have a scale of over 100 million downloads, it has become the highest-
rated travel app in the world that operates at this kind of scale. For us, that is a meaningful 
endorsement from the travellers we serve. 
 
We are also expanding our relationship with travellers beyond the ticket, food on trains, metro 
tickets and our new Bharat Darshan rail package offerings. These have enhanced our ixigo 
train app, where we are able to serve more parts of the journey. 
 
In buses, AbhiBus has been growing faster than the overall OTA bus market for close to 3 
years. Expanding supply, building our brand in markets where we have room to grow, and 
improving the travel experience continue to drive that performance. Our new women's zone 
is a good example of how we are improving this experience. 
 
It helps women travelling alone make more informed choices through ratings from other 
women, information about seats next to other women and other women-friendly features that 
build trust in making operator choices and see choices with more confidence. 
 
Flight remains challenging in the near term as capacity has not returned as quickly as we had 
expected, and we are seeing the impact of oil prices reflected in the 30% increase in fares Y-
o-Y on several routes. International travel has been more encouraging, with our international 
flight GTV growing 59% year-on-year. 
 
Let me spend a little time on hotels because we see a significant opportunity to build our next 
major business here. We are disclosing hotels in the same level of detail as other businesses 
now because product-market fit is emerging and the business has become more material. 
 
This reflects our growing confidence even as we recognise that we are still early in this 
journey. We now do more than 5,100 room nights per day net of cancellations, 4.7 lakh room 
nights for the quarter, a growth of 3.9x compared to last year and a growth of over 50% versus 
the comparable Q1 number. 
 
In Q2, hotel GTV reached INR111 crores, up 39% sequentially and 2.6x year-on-year. 
Revenue grew more than six-fold year-on-year to INR8.1 crores, and our gross take rate 
exceeded 12% and became the highest in our business. Contribution margin improved from 
minus 55% of revenue a year ago to minus 15%, with a contribution loss of INR 1.2 crores

The reason why our unit economics are able to develop some headroom is that more than 
86% of our hotel bookings came from travellers which were already on our platforms or our 
captive users. Having said that, as we said in the past, we will not be shy about continuing to 
invest in growing hotels as a strategic category for our business and aspire to remain the 
fastest-growing OTA in our country in this line of business as well. 
 
The TAM of the hotel opportunity is proven in India, and it is the largest profitability pool 
globally for OTAs. ixigo's opportunity is particularly compelling in the budget, mid-market 
and independent hotels, where online penetration is low, and travellers need greater reliability 
and peace of mind. 
 
About 60% of hotel room nights in India sell below 2,000 a night, and independent hotels 
account for 73% of routes as per the recent VIDEC industry report. Out of the 70,000 hotels 
in India that we sell, we are now tied up directly with over 12,000 hotels across about 1,100 
towns, up from 10,000 hotels last quarter. 
 
Our thesis on hotels fits our customer base closely. 94% of our transactions involve travel to 
or from Tier 2 and 3 cities, and more than 9 out of 10 trips we sell out by train or bus. Many 
travellers looking for an affordable room are already booking their journey with us. Our 
aspiration remains to become the largest player serving this part of the hotel market over the 
next 4 to 5 years. 
 
The size of the opportunity supports that ambition. VIDEC estimates India's hotel market at 
about INR 1.57 lakh crores in FY26, projected to reach INR 1.94 lakh crores by FY28. 
Lodging represents as much as 30% of total travel spending. Hotel bookings through OTAs 
are projected to grow around 19% annually from INR40,200 crores to INR57,000 crores over 
that period. 
 
Hotels are already the second largest OTA category, around 3x the size of the OTA rail 
market. These estimates may still understate the opportunity, particularly non-hotel 
accommodation that remains largely offline. 
 
Building this business requires investment. Much of our spending on hotels, product, 
technology and people sits in the group costs below contribution margin. So the segment's 
contribution loss captures only a small part of what we are investing, and Saurabh will explain 
this in more detail in a bit. 
 
Our core business profitability gives us the capacity to keep funding this opportunity. We 
have an existing customer base, and we are now going to expand the direct supply. And as 
the unit economics start to come in, there is a lot of work to be done ahead in order to drive 
repeat business and achieve reliable state based on direct supply, better fulfilment and support 
when things go wrong.

And we need to build peace of mind products in this category as well. Our ambition is to 
become the largest player serving this part of the market. And over the next 4 to 5 years, we 
believe we can achieve that ambition. 
 
We will continue to calibrate our investment based on that progress and the long-term returns 
that we see. Across the group, AI is helping us improve our service and productivity even as 
we continue to invest further in enhancing our capabilities with it. TARA handled 45 lakh 
queries before and after the booking and now resolves 94% of chat queries without human 
intervention and 82% of customer calls end-to-end. 
 
AI-handled queries more than doubled year-on-year while customer service costs did not rise 
in proportion. That is already giving us greater capacity to serve travellers as we grow. We 
also remain conscious of the advances that consumer AI agents could bring to travel 
discovery and booking. 
 
Our platforms are already available as natively integrated apps on ChatGPT, and we are 
continuing to build on ixigo NEXT, our own agentic AI products and voice-first experiences. 
We believe that in a world where AI agents develop the potential to do consumer bookings 
on behalf of the customer, there is an opportunity to become the most contextually aware AI 
agent for travel for our users. 
 
In fact, we demoed a fully agentic booking flow complete with payments at the recently 
concluded GFS conference in Mumbai, and we await regulatory clarity before launching the 
same. 
 
Further, we want to stress again on this, that we will differentiate our company by actually 
building the best peace-of-mind products for our travellers and using AI to solve their real-
world problems more meaningfully by building those relevant products suited for our market. 
 
For example, our recently launched Smart Lock product for flights is a perfect example of 
using AI to build better experiences. Smart Lock is an agentic AI product that finds and locks 
the cheapest flights based on preferences. You can tell it your route, budget, and travel 
preferences. 
 
It scans the airfares 24/7 and locks the first flight that fits within that budget and matches 
your preferences. If nothing matches by the time scanning ends, you get your full premium 
back in ixigo money right away. 
 
Finally, a word on Freshbus. We are proud to have backed the team early. Reducing our stake 
now reflects our focus on being an asset-light tech and distribution platform. And the lessons 
from that investment that we learned now help us to service bus operators with more 
understanding of the unique opportunities and challenges that EV-based plus operator space. 
Freshbus remains a valued commercial partner, and Saurabh will explain the exceptional gain 
portion separately in a bit.

acceleration of our hotel trajectory to keep gaining share and continue investing in building 
AI platforms to improve both customer experience and productivity. We will keep balancing 
these opportunities with the responsibility to deliver long-term returns for our shareholders. 
Thank you to our customers, partners, teams and shareholders for your continued trust.
